day.headline: A Rat day — Dragon and Monkey are in step.

reasons: Ox pairs with Rat — a harmonious day
signs.motif: a jacket for the wrong weather
signs.message: You dressed for a colder city. Ditch the layer, head out.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a message read by the wrong person
signs.message: Wrong person saw it. Stand behind it, no frantic follow-up.

reasons: Rat's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: a colleague you never talk to
signs.message: Say more than hi to the person two desks over.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Nobody clocked that win. Tell one person, no throat-clearing.

reasons: Monkey and Rat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the newsletter you never unsubscribe from
signs.message: Two clicks at the bottom of it. Do that today.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a new sign on an old door
signs.message: The corner place has a new name. Go read the menu.

reasons: Dragon and Rat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Dead batteries, three dried pens. Clear those out, shut it.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Write the amount down for your own records. That's enough.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Nothing in there has changed in weeks. Leave it parked.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Third pass, same pages, nothing landing. Shut the book.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Rat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Half-sorted piles can stay half-sorted. Push them aside, get comfortable.

reasons: Horse opposes Rat — a day to take slowly
signs.message: You've memorized it by now. Close it, phone face-down.
